about: The detector's Goblin Barrel and Goblin boxes (confidence >= 0.35, the live threshold) on every in-game frame of live match runs/live/20261120-185026 (raw.yolo.jsonl, weights data/det/runs/r3). frames: [frame, t, dets]; t = wall time - 3.4 s (about the match clock the opponent-play reader ran on); det = [class index, side, conf, x1, y1, x2, y2, tile x, tile y]. barrels: the six real Goblin Barrels, one mid-flight frame each, seen by eye (the third and sixth are evolved).
